derived_results.claim: The r92 randomized 300k screen was independently reproduced from its fixed seed and formulas, including the exact displayed worst-cell mean/variance/radius/lower bound. The seven cells with simultaneous lower bound <18 are exactly (15,0),(14,0),(15,1),(13,0),(14,1),(15,2),(12,0).

Using the r93 N=128 widened equal-probability lower-envelope construction, all seven low-margin cells have positive lower sums: 10.24315, 8.23358, 8.84763, 6.42089, 6.88236, 7.66814, and 4.79115 respectively.

The seven obligations can collapse to two N=128 shared theta rectangles: mu 14..15 x sigma 0..2 has lower sum 0.86016343 and covers five low-margin cells, while mu 12..13 x sigma 0 has lower sum 2.48044258 and covers the remaining two. A single rectangle mu 12..15 x sigma 0..2 is negative at N=128 (-5.89362) but positive at N=192 (0.293455) and N=256 (4.17438), so one-rectangle collapse is possible at finer partition resolution.

The R quantile CDF is elementary: F_R(r)=r^(31/2)(1155-2170r+1023r^2)/8 for R~Beta(31/2,3). For U~Beta(37/2,37/2), X=2U-1 has CDF from the recurrence J0=(x sqrt(1-x^2)+asin x)/2 and Jk=x(1-x^2)^(k+1/2)/(2k+2)+(2k+1)J(k-1)/(2k+2), k=1..17. Thus incomplete-beta evaluation is unnecessary.

A 120-digit Decimal path using Machin pi, alternating arctan remainders, positive asin Taylor with geometric tail bound, and widened Decimal sqrt verifies all 127 original +/-1e-8 interior quantile brackets without calling incomplete beta. Minimum target-CDF slack is 1.7332465581e-9 for R and 2.9272674604e-9 for U.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The single N=192 shared rectangle has only about 0.293 lower-sum margin; the two N=128 shared rectangles have larger 0.860 and 2.480 margins and are safer targets for outward rounding.
The elementary CDF derivations remove the incomplete-beta dependency, but the current Decimal evaluation is not an end-to-end formal interval library for every arithmetic operation.
The six new per-cell/shared lower sums were computed in binary64; fully outward-rounded recomputation remains pending.
All results remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG/four-corner iid Gaussian setup.
